subject: MAP performance artifacts delivery & exec readout cadence
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@bluewave.ai>
Cc: Samir Rao <samir.rao@bluewave.ai>
Date: 2026-11-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: MAP kickoff: performance artifacts we'll deliver this week

Emily / Samir —

Thanks again for the time today. As discussed during the MAP review, our next milestone before the C-level readout is a compact artifact bundle you can share internally that summarizes the performance benchmarking results we ran against your workload. Goal: give your infra/ML lead clear numbers (median P95 latency, TTFT, tokens/sec throughput, concurrency saturation points) and the slides to present to leadership.

I'll coordinate delivery with our benchmarks team and Jordan on the SRE side. Planned contents (we'll attach by EOD Nov 24 unless you prefer an earlier slot):
- One-page executive summary (topline P50/P95 latency, TTFT, throughput, recommended config)
- Raw CSV exports (per-run token-level trace + aggregate metrics)
- Grafana dashboard link with time-series for the test window
- PPTX readout deck with methodology appendix and test harness config
- Short recorded demo (30–45s) showing cold-start TTFT and steady-state throughput

Question for you: do you want the artifacts organized for an internal slide pack only, or should we also prepare a short appendix with suggested procurement language (SLA / committed concurrency) for the MAP? Happy to include both.

Next steps: I’ll loop Jordan (solutions) and Karthik (benchmark lead) to pull the artifacts together and propose a 30-minute exec readout slot next week.

Thanks,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@bluewave.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Rao <samir.rao@bluewave.ai>
Date: 2026-11-20T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: performance artifacts we'll deliver this week

Vivek —

Thanks, this looks good. Two quick asks from our side before you run the tests:
1) Please include TTFT at both cold-start and after a 2-minute warm cache for the same request set.
2) Can you add a small table that maps the load profile you used to our internal request categories (ingest, inference-batch, query) — that helps our product team align the numbers to cost buckets.

Procurement language would be great to have in the appendix — especially anything around how you define "committed concurrency" and what happens if we hit a sustained overload.

Preferred readout window: Dec 2–4 mornings (PST). If you have a concrete slot, we can lock it.

Best,
Emily
Emily Chen
Head of Platform Engineering | BlueWave Analytics
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Chen <emily.chen@bluewave.ai>, Samir Rao <samir.rao@bluewave.ai>
Date: 2026-11-21T08:15:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: MAP kickoff: performance artifacts we'll deliver this week

Team —

Looping you in to scope the artifacts for BlueWave (see Emily's asks above). Karthik: can you confirm test matrix changes (cold-start + 2-min warmed TTFT). Jordan: can you prepare the Grafana dashboard snapshot and the recorded demo clip. Laura: please draft the procurement appendix language and a short SLO/SLA paragraph for the MAP.

Target deliverables and internal owners: 
- Karthik: raw CSVs + one-page summary + methodology appendix (due 2026-11-24 EOD)
- Jordan: Grafana link + demo gif + exportable dashboard panels (due 2026-11-25)
- Laura: procurement appendix + suggested contract language (due 2026-11-25)

Emily / Samir, we propose a 30-min executive readout on Dec 3 at 9:00am PST — does that work? If yes we'll send a calendar invite and the final artifacts 24 hours before.

Thanks,
Vivek

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: MAP kickoff: performance artifacts we'll deliver this week
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@bluewave.ai>
Cc: Samir Rao <samir.rao@bluewave.ai>
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Emily Chen <emily.chen@bluewave.ai>
Date: 2026-11-24T17:32:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP performance artifacts: results and CSVs attached

Vivek / team / Emily —

Attached are the artifacts from our run window (test harness: rw-harness-v3, model: open-rw-13b-q4f16). High level notes first:
- Cold-start TTFT (median): 420ms; Cold-start P95 TTFT: 890ms (measured across 30 runs)
- Warmed TTFT (after 120s of steady traffic): median 120ms; P95 230ms
- Steady-state throughput (tokens/sec) at 4 concurrent hosts: 58k tokens/sec aggregate (14.5k t/s host)
- Concurrency saturation: beyond 16 concurrent requests per host we observed degraded tail latency; recommended committed concurrency headroom = 12 reqs/host for your 99th percentile target

Attachments included: MAP_Perf_Results_20261203.pdf (executive summary + methodology), latency_throughput_raw_20261203.csv (row-level run traces), exec_readout_slides_20261203.pptx (deck).

Methodology highlights (also in the PDF appendix):
- Workload mapping: we used BlueWave request categories you provided; ingest = 25% of traffic (short prompts), query = 60% (mid-length), inference-batch = 15% (longer sequences)
- Each run was 10 minutes, with a 2-minute warm-up. Cold-starts sampled by restarting the inference process and issuing a single request every 30s.
- All runs executed in your requested us-west-2 region nodes; kernel selection tuned for float16 with KV cache warm path.

I'll push the raw CSV to the Drive folder and refresh the Grafana snapshot now.

- Karthik
Benchmark Lead | Redwood Inference

(attachment: latency_throughput_raw_20261203.csv)
(attachment: MAP_Perf_Results_20261203.pdf)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-11-25T09:07:00-08:00
Subject: Grafana snapshot + demo clip for BlueWave readout

Emily —

Sharing the Grafana snapshot and a short demo gif. Links below:
- Grafana panel export: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/perf/bluewave-dashboard?orgId=1&panelId=12 (time window: Nov 21 10:00 - Nov 24 18:00 PST)
- Demo (cold-start -> warm steady-state): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1demo-gif-bluewave

Quick summary of panels to highlight in the exec deck:
1) Cold-start TTFT distribution (P50/P95 lines)
2) Throughput vs concurrency curve (helps assess committed concurrency)
3) Token-level latency heatmap (good to surface anomalies)

I'll embed the three panels into the PPTX and attach the panels JSON export to the Drive folder.

-Jordan
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

(attachment: grafana_panel_export_bluewave.json)
From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@bluewave.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Rao <samir.rao@bluewave.ai>
Date: 2026-12-01T11:24:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP performance artifacts: results and CSVs attached

Team —

Thanks for the thorough pack. I reviewed the PDF and slides; the appendix language looks reasonable. A few clarifications before the exec readout: 
- Can you add a single slide that maps the recommended committed concurrency to an estimated monthly cost delta? (ballpark is fine; our finance partner wants an order-of-magnitude)
- On the procurement appendix, please call out the escalation path if we hit sustained overload (we prefer automatic fallback to a lower-cost variant + an alerting cadence).

Confirmed: Dec 3, 9:00am PST works for the readout. Please send the final artifacts 24 hours prior.

Also please send the DocuSign packet for the SOW when available so I can route to our procurement team.

Best,
Emily
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@bluewave.ai>, Samir Rao <samir.rao@bluewave.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-03T16:48:00-08:00
Subject: Final artifact bundle + DocuSign link (MAP readout prep)

Emily / Samir —

Attached are the final artifacts and links, delivered 24 hours before the scheduled readout:
- MAP_Perf_Results_20261203.pdf (executive summary + methodology + appendix)
- exec_readout_slides_20261203.pptx (final deck; includes cost-impact slide added per request)
- latency_throughput_raw_20261203.csv (raw traces)
- Grafana snapshot: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/perf/bluewave-dashboard?orgId=1&panelId=12
- Drive folder with exports & panels: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cBLUEWAVE-MAP
- DocuSign SOW packet: https://www.docusign.com/packet/SOW-BW-1947

Quick summary of the cost slide: estimated incremental monthly cost to achieve committed concurrency headroom (12 reqs/host) ranges between $6k–$9k depending on sustained token volume assumptions (details in note at bottom of slide).

Readout invite will follow. On the procurement appendix we included automatic fallback policy language and a two-level escalation path (customer support -> engineering on-call). Laura will be on the readout to talk through that section.

See you tomorrow at 9:00am PST.

Thanks,
Vivek

(attachments: MAP_Perf_Results_20261203.pdf, exec_readout_slides_20261203.pptx, latency_throughput_raw_20261203.csv)
